security_audit.summary: The only confirmed risks are three helper scripts that can overwrite arbitrary output paths when --output is supplied. The remaining findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, inline reference links, generic anti-pattern headings, and a standard .env example copy command; no prompt injection or exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts accept unrestricted output file paths.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve --output to a safe project-relative path, refuse parent directory traversal, and warn before overwriting existing files.

remediation.issue: The .env setup example can overwrite an existing local environment file.
remediation.suggestion: Use a safer setup instruction that checks whether .env already exists before copying .env.example.

remediation.issue: Deployment command examples can affect real infrastructure if run without review.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit review guidance before npm, pip, Docker, docker-compose, and kubectl examples are executed.

content.value_statement: DevOps work often requires repeatable pipeline, infrastructure, and deployment patterns. This skill provides scripts and reference guides for CI/CD, IaC, deployment, and operations review.
actual_capabilities: Documents workflows for CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and deployment strategy review.
Provides helper scripts for pipeline, Terraform, and deployment task scaffolding.
Validates a target path before running helper script analysis.
Prints basic status reports with target, completion status, and finding count.
Can emit helper script results as JSON to a requested output file.
Lists common setup, quality check, Docker, and Kubernetes command examples.
limitations: The helper scripts are scaffold-level tools and do not generate complete production pipelines.
The reference guides are generic and require project-specific review before use.
Command examples may change local files, containers, or cluster resources when executed.
The skill does not manage credentials, cloud accounts, or live deployment approvals.

use_cases.title: Review a DevOps Baseline
use_cases.description: Assess a repository for CI/CD, infrastructure, deployment, security, performance, and maintainability practices.

use_cases.title: Plan Infrastructure Automation
use_cases.description: Create a practical checklist for Terraform structure, validation, environment setup, and deployment readiness.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Deployment Workflow
use_cases.description: Outline quality checks, build steps, container operations, deployment commands, and rollback considerations.

prompt_templates.title: Review My DevOps Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this repository for basic DevOps readiness. Focus on CI/CD, infrastructure files, deployment steps, and missing operational documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Pipeline Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CI/CD pipeline plan for this project. Include validation, test, build, artifact, deployment, and rollback stages.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Terraform Practices
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess the infrastructure as code approach in this repository. Identify structure, state, variable, security, and review improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Deployment Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a deployment strategy for this service. Include environments, release controls, observability checks, failure handling, and approval gates.

output_examples.input: Review a service repository for DevOps readiness.
output: Summary of current CI/CD, infrastructure, deployment, and monitoring coverage.
Prioritized gaps with practical next steps.

output_examples.input: Plan a deployment workflow for a containerized application.
output: Build, test, image, release, and deployment stages.
Operational risks that need human approval.
State, variable, and secret handling considerations.
Review items for reliability and maintainability.

best_practices: Review commands before execution, especially Docker, Kubernetes, package installation, and deployment commands.
Run helper scripts in a clean working tree and write outputs to reviewed project paths.
Adapt the generic reference guides to the repository, cloud provider, and release process.
anti_patterns: Do not run deployment examples against production resources without explicit approval.
Do not store real secrets in generated reports, examples, or copied environment files.
Do not treat the scaffold scripts as complete CI/CD or Terraform generators.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy applications automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, examples, and scaffold scripts. Users must review and approve real deployments.

faq.question: Can it create a full production pipeline?
faq.answer: No. The scripts are basic scaffolds. A production pipeline needs project-specific configuration and testing.

faq.question: Which tools does it reference?
faq.answer: It references Python, npm, pip, Docker, docker-compose, kubectl, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and common cloud platforms.

faq.question: Is it safe to run the included commands?
faq.answer: Review each command first. Some examples can install packages, build containers, or apply Kubernetes manifests.

faq.question: Does it handle secrets?
faq.answer: No. It does not manage secrets. Keep credentials out of reports, examples, and generated files.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
